main.description: Add a Base token to Krao's catalog, or change one (by symbol). Its price is read from a Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH: the given pool, or else the pool of the factory with the most liquidity. The pool and the token's decimals are checked on-chain. Token admins (the indexer's safety admins) only; requires service auth for the indexer.

symbol.description: Cashtag symbol: a letter, then letters and digits (2-10 characters).

quote.description: What the pool prices the token in. 'usd': a fixed 1 dollar (USD stablecoins), no pool.

pool.description: Uniswap v3 pool of the token and the quote token. Default: found through the factory.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: Bad symbol or address, or the contract is not an ERC-20 on Base.

errors.name: NoPool
errors.description: No usable pool for the token and the quote token.
